name: workbuddy-obsidian-plugin
description: Obsidian plugin: chat with a locally installed WorkBuddy (Tencent) through its bundled CLI.

scripts.build:test: esbuild src/runtime/protocol.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --outfile=tests/.build/protocol.mjs && esbuild src/runtime/context.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --outfile=tests/.build/context.mjs && esbuild src/runtime/history.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --outfile=tests/.build/history.mjs && esbuild src/runtime/locate.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --outfile=tests/.build/locate.mjs && esbuild src/runtime/i18n.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --outfile=tests/.build/i18n.mjs && esbuild src/runtime/cliArgs.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --outfile=tests/.build/cliArgs.mjs
scripts.smoke:live: npm run build:test && esbuild src/runtime/cliClient.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --external:child_process --external:fs --external:os --external:path --outfile=tests/.build/cliClient.mjs && node tests/smoke-live.mjs
